require 'sinatra'
require 'openssl'
require 'json'
require 'fileutils'
require 'securerandom'

class ChunkedUploadServer < Sinatra::Base
  UPLOAD_DIR = '/var/uploads'
  MAX_CHUNK_SIZE = 1024 * 1024  # 1MB per chunk
  MAX_TOTAL_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024  # 50MB total
  ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = %w[.pdf .doc .docx .txt .png .jpg].freeze
  
  @@sessions = {}
  @@session_mutex = Mutex.new

  before do
    content_type :json
  end

  helpers do
    def authenticate!
      token = request.env['HTTP_X_AUTH_TOKEN']
      halt 401, { error: 'unauthorized' }.to_json unless token
      expected = ENV.fetch('AUTH_TOKEN')
      halt 401, { error: 'unauthorized' }.to_json unless Rack::Utils.secure_compare(token, expected)
    end

    def validate_session_id(sid)
      halt 400, { error: 'invalid session' }.to_json unless sid =~ /\A[a-f0-9]{32}\z/
      sid
    end

    def safe_filename(name)
      # Strip path components
      base = File.basename(name.to_s)
      # Remove null bytes and control chars
      base = base.gsub(/[\x00-\x1f]/, '')
      # Collapse any remaining path separators
      base = base.gsub(/[\/\\]/, '_')
      halt 400, { error: 'invalid filename' }.to_json if base.empty? || base.start_with?('.')
      base
    end

    def valid_extension?(filename)
      ext = File.extname(filename).downcase
      ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.include?(ext)
    end

    def compute_checksum(data)
      OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(data)
    end

    # Validates that reassembled chunks don't exceed declared total
    # Uses running total to prevent memory exhaustion
    def validate_chunk_bounds(session, chunk_data, chunk_index)
      declared_total = session[:declared_size]
      chunk_size = chunk_data.bytesize
      
      # Calculate cumulative size including this chunk
      # Each chunk occupies a slot; sum all received chunks plus this one
      cumulative = session[:chunks_received].sum { |_k, v| v[:size] } + chunk_size
      
      # Boundary check: cumulative bytes must not exceed declared total
      # The declared_size is provided by client at session init
      if cumulative > declared_total + MAX_CHUNK_SIZE
        return false
      end
      true
    end

    def assemble_file(session)
      output_path = File.join(UPLOAD_DIR, session[:target_dir], session[:filename])
      dir = File.dirname(output_path)
      
      # Verify output path is within UPLOAD_DIR
      real_upload = File.realpath(UPLOAD_DIR)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(dir)
      real_output_dir = File.realpath(dir)
      unless real_output_dir.start_with?(real_upload)
        raise SecurityError, "Path traversal detected"
      end

      # Reassemble chunks in order
      File.open(output_path, 'wb') do |f|
        session[:total_chunks].times do |i|
          chunk_info = session[:chunks_received][i]
          if chunk_info
            f.write(chunk_info[:data])
          end
        end
      end

      # Verify final checksum
      assembled_data = File.binread(output_path)
      actual_checksum = compute_checksum(assembled_data)
      
      if session[:expected_checksum] && actual_checksum != session[:expected_checksum]
        File.delete(output_path) if File.exist?(output_path)
        return nil
      end
      
      output_path
    end
  end

  # Initialize upload session
  post '/api/upload/init' do
    authenticate!
    
    data = JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)
    filename = safe_filename(data[:filename])
    halt 400, { error: 'invalid extension' }.to_json unless valid_extension?(filename)
    
    declared_size = data[:total_size].to_i
    halt 400, { error: 'size exceeds maximum' }.to_json if declared_size > MAX_TOTAL_SIZE
    halt 400, { error: 'invalid size' }.to_json if declared_size <= 0
    
    total_chunks = data[:total_chunks].to_i
    halt 400, { error: 'invalid chunks' }.to_json if total_chunks <= 0 || total_chunks > 1000
    
    # Validate chunk count is reasonable for declared size
    min_expected_chunks = (declared_size.to_f / MAX_CHUNK_SIZE).ceil
    halt 400, { error: 'chunk count mismatch' }.to_json if total_chunks < min_expected_chunks - 1
    
    session_id = SecureRandom.hex(16)
    target_dir = SecureRandom.hex(8)
    
    @@session_mutex.synchronize do
      @@sessions[session_id] = {
        filename: filename,
        declared_size: declared_size,
        total_chunks: total_chunks,
        chunks_received: {},
        target_dir: target_dir,
        expected_checksum: data[:checksum],
        created_at: Time.now.to_i,
        completed: false
      }
    end
    
    { session_id: session_id, target_dir: target_dir }.to_json
  end

  # Upload a chunk
  post '/api/upload/chunk' do
    authenticate!
    
    session_id = validate_session_id(params[:session_id])
    chunk_index = params[:chunk_index].to_i
    
    session = nil
    @@session_mutex.synchronize do
      session = @@sessions[session_id]
    end
    
    halt 404, { error: 'session not found' }.to_json unless session
    halt 400, { error: 'session completed' }.to_json if session[:completed]
    halt 400, { error: 'invalid chunk index' }.to_json if chunk_index < 0 || chunk_index >= session[:total_chunks]
    
    chunk_file = params[:chunk]
    halt 400, { error: 'no chunk data' }.to_json unless chunk_file
    
    chunk_data = chunk_file[:tempfile].read
    halt 400, { error: 'chunk too large' }.to_json if chunk_data.bytesize > MAX_CHUNK_SIZE
    
    # Validate bounds
    unless validate_chunk_bounds(session, chunk_data, chunk_index)
      halt 400, { error: 'size overflow detected' }.to_json
    end
    
    # Store chunk
    @@session_mutex.synchronize do
      session[:chunks_received][chunk_index] = {
        data: chunk_data,
        size: chunk_data.bytesize,
        checksum: compute_checksum(chunk_data)
      }
    end
    
    # Check if all chunks received
    if session[:chunks_received].size == session[:total_chunks]
      result = assemble_file(session)
      if result
        session[:completed] = true
        return { status: 'complete', path: session[:target_dir] }.to_json
      else
        halt 422, { error: 'checksum mismatch' }.to_json
      end
    end
    
    { status: 'ok', received: session[:chunks_received].size }.to_json
  end

  # Check session status
  get '/api/upload/status/:session_id' do
    authenticate!
    session_id = validate_session_id(params[:session_id])
    
    session = nil
    @@session_mutex.synchronize do
      session = @@sessions[session_id]
    end
    
    halt 404, { error: 'not found' }.to_json unless session
    
    {
      filename: session[:filename],
      chunks_received: session[:chunks_received].size,
      total_chunks: session[:total_chunks],
      completed: session[:completed]
    }.to_json
  end
end
